input: Draw up a five-year property investment strategy

gold.taskTitle: Build a Five-Year Property Investment Strategy
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured, actionable five-year plan for investing in property, tailored to the user's financial position, goals, and market preferences.

questions.title: What is your total available capital to start investing?
questions.description: Understand the user's starting budget, including savings, equity, or borrowing capacity.

questions.title: Are you investing for rental income, capital growth, or both?
questions.description: Clarify the primary financial objective driving the investment strategy.

questions.title: Which country or region are you targeting for purchases?
questions.description: Identify the geographic market to ensure the strategy reflects relevant laws, taxes, and market conditions.

questions.title: Do you plan to buy residential, commercial, or mixed-use properties?
questions.description: Determine the property type so the strategy can focus on the right asset class.

questions.title: How many properties are you aiming to own by year five?
questions.description: Establish a concrete portfolio size target to structure the acquisition timeline around.

questions.title: What is your risk tolerance if property values drop significantly?
questions.description: Gauge the user's comfort with market downturns to shape leverage and diversification decisions.

questions.title: Will you self-manage properties or use letting agents?
questions.description: Understand the user's intended level of hands-on involvement to factor in management costs and time.
